Consequently, for every integer w>=32, r=2^w, U=AND of r disjoint width-w OR clauses, V(Y)=1-U(-Y) on an independent clone, and F=2U(X)V(Y)-1, every pair of original complete positive/negative-prime queues with independently arbitrary positive packing-feasible weights and arbitrary ordered covers satisfies C_mix(F)/I(F)>w/2592 for EVERY fixed normalized output mixture alpha Q_+ +(1-alpha)Q_-, alpha in [0,1]. This lower bound includes all finite runs, repeated gates, overlapping subsets and output ambiguity. Meanwhile H(F)<8I(F), so this is an obstruction to this fixed-pair coding route, not an FEI counterexample. Each original root normalizer is retained separately.
